notes: No og:image or twitter:image meta tag is shipped by www.cockroachlabs.com homepage, /product/continuum/, or /pricing/ as of 2026-11-01; the homepage hero browser capture fills the og surface.
https://www.cockroachlabs.com/product/ and /product/cockroachdb/ now 302-redirect to /pricing/; /product/continuum/ is the live product page captured instead.
Full-page capture of the homepage was discarded: the scroll-jacked pinned hero repeats nine times in fullPage mode, producing a 9708px artifact; replaced with a viewport hero capture.
v19.2 Admin UI screenshots in the docs repo were rejected as outdated (2019-era navy-blue UI that no longer matches current tokens).
docs.cockroachlabs.com CSS exposes only generic Mintlify default variables, not brand tokens, so the docs surface was spec'd from the capture rather than its stylesheet.
Docs capture retains the site's cookie-consent dialog over part of the sidebar; the page remains fully identifiable.
